problem.title_en: Floor recurrence generating digits of an algebraic number (Graham–Pollak)

posed.citation: catalog JSP-000391 ([GrPo70] Note on a nonlinear recurrence related to sqrt 2, Math. Mag. 1970, 143–145; [St05] On families of nonlinear recurrences related to digits, J. Integer Seq. 2005)

recipients.contribution_en: Complete Lean 4 formalization of the Graham–Pollak digit phenomenon: with u_1=1 and u_{n+1}=⌊√2(u_n+1/2)⌋ (integer closed form step u = Nat.sqrt(2u(u+1))), the quantity d_n = u_{2n+1} − 2·u_{2n−1} is a binary digit (∈ {0,1}) — the nth digit of √2. Full proof chain (square_bound, step_le_2u_sub2, step_sq_bound/upper, step_step_digit, u_strict_mono, d_mem_zero_one), verified against Lean v4.34.0 / mathlib v4.34.0, 0 sorry/admit/axiom.

# Candidate citation: 000391

## English

Floor recurrence generating digits of an algebraic number (Graham-Pollak) (catalog 000391; [GrPo70] Note on a nonlinear recurrence related to sqrt 2 (1970); [St05] J. Integer Seq. 2005).

Status of this candidate record:

- Mathematical status: solved.
- Lean formalization: available (formalization contributor: Shiqiang Chen,
  independent researcher) in the public repository
  `github.com/shunfeng8421/jsp301-lean` at commit `8de5b93406f89c279034fe84a7ab140255f1e10d`.
- Eligible to claim: yes, subject to independent verification and review.

Scoped constructive component (2026-09-18):

2. Axiom audit reports exactly `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`; no
   `sorry`/`admit`/`axiom`.

`verification/build-current-release.log`.

## 中文

已书面确认收件人（2026-09-18，公开主页 https://github.com/shunfeng8421）：

- **shiqiang-chen** — 陈世强（Shiqiang Chen），独立研究员。贡献：Complete Lean 4 formalization of the Graham-Pollak digit phenomenon: d_n = u_{2n+1}-2*u_{2n-1} in {0,1} (binary digits of sqrt 2), with full proof chain, 0 sorry/admit. scoped to the core digit-binary claim.

statement_comparison.basis: The theorem d_mem_zero_one states exactly that the Graham-Pollak quantity d_n = u_{2n+1} - 2*u_{2n-1} is a binary digit (0 or 1) for n >= 2 — the core of the Graham-Pollak digit phenomenon, where d_n is the nth binary digit of sqrt 2. This is the integer-only closed-form formalization (step u = Nat.sqrt(2u(u+1)) = floor(sqrt 2 (u + 1/2))). At commit 8de5b93 the native_decide axiom was eliminated: u 3 = 3 is proved explicitly, so the target depends only on standard axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

statement.text: Jsp391.d_mem_zero_one : forall n, 2 <= n -> d n = 0 or d n = 1, where d n = u (2*n+1) - 2*(u (2*n-1)) and u is the Graham-Pollak sequence (u 1 = 1, u (n+1) = step (u n), step u = Nat.sqrt (2u(u+1))).
